head: Abu Bakr

keywords.def: the one who separates truth from falsehood: Umar's title
a duty you must carry out

questions.q: Compare how Abu Bakr and Umar became caliph.
questions.a: Abu Bakr was chosen by the Companions at a meeting; Umar was nominated by Abu Bakr after consultation and accepted.

questions.q: Write Umar's 'first speech notes' in the portal response box (our own words, not a quotation): three promises a just caliph should make. Start: 'As your caliph I promise to ...'
questions.a: Promises such as justice, caring for the poor, following the Qur'an and Sunnah, accepting correction
The one who separates truth from falsehood

questions.q: Stretch: why is leadership called an amanah (trust)?
questions.a: The leader will be asked by Allah about those he led.
A) Commander of the Believers. Umar was the first called by this title.
A heavy trust, because Allah asks the leader about his people.
